summary: Traced the restart path that previous snapshot accounts left as a limitation, and recorded it as a new investigation (@restart_frontier_anchor) with one Behavior and a source-grounded, defect-refuting account. On startup replayLog anchors the log reader on the most recent stored snapshot, the entry log initialises committed and processed to that same snapshot index, the state-loading gate refuses a persisted commit outside the stored range, and the single Initial recovery reports that same index, which setInitialStatus stores as both the snapshot index and the pushed index, so replay begins exactly one past the anchor. For an on-disk state machine the opened data index is tracked separately and replayed entries at or below it become applied placeholders rather than being executed again, with configuration-change entries excepted. Limits kept explicit: source-only (no restart executed), snapshot-store/logdb desynchronisation untraced, and offload/reload plus session-entry handling outside the trace.
